source_text.body:
Find job postings matching a resume and unemployment help
A commenter suggests setting up Cowork to look for job postings based on the user's resume and asking Claude how to apply for unemployment and other services.
·
May 1, 2026
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
CL
Claude
What they did
A commenter suggested using Cowork as a standing task runner: feed it your resume, have it watch for matching job postings, and tailor the resume to each job’s requirements without inventing experience. The same thread also suggests asking Claude for step-by-step help applying for unemployment and other support programs, plus using Cowork to track service deadlines and draft inbox replies for interview requests that the user would review before sending.
How it went
This was advice, not a reported case study, so the thread gives no results, numbers, or evidence it was carried through. It lays out possible workflows but not how well they worked.
Worth knowing
The main catch the commenter calls out is to keep the tailoring grounded in your actual resume and review any drafted responses before sending.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Read my resume at [file path] and search for current job postings in [city or remote] that fit my experience in [field]. Give me a list of [10] strong matches with title, company, pay if listed, link, and a one-line reason each fits. Then explain how to apply for unemployment benefits and other help available in [state or country], with the official links and the steps in order. Don't submit any applications or forms.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeCode/comments/1snb9vn/just_got_let_go_of_my_sales_job_whats_the_best
